text: The City of Toronto passed the Central Waterfront Secondary Plan in April 2003 and subsequently enacted zoning by-laws for the East Bayfront (By-law No. 1049-2006) and Keating Channel West (By-law 1174-2010). Within these two precincts, there were numerous appeals to the Central Waterfront Secondary Plan and the area specific Zoning By-laws. After many years of discussions, pre-hearing conferences, mediation sessions and OMB hearings, most of the appeals in the Central Waterfront have been resolved. This report requests further direction regarding the resolution of appeals relating to 351 and 369 Lake Shore Boulevard East to be dealt with by the LPAT.
